Max Health

The maximum amount of Health the character can have. 1 Health point is recovered each turn, regeneration rate can be increased by camping or visiting a Healer's Hut. Health below 30% poses a death risk.
Max Sanity

The maximum amount of Sanity the character can have. Regeneration of each Sanity point consumes 2 Morale, up to 20% of maximum Sanity per turn. Sanity below 30% poses a risk of the character leaving your group.
Max Faith
The maximum amount of Faith the character can have. 1 Faith point is recovered each turn, but you can also perform the Spiritual Healing ritual. Faith below 30% causes gradual Health loss.

Human Craftsman
An odd shoemaker you met when a dragon attacked your people. He was determined to have a virgin princess as reward for his clever dragon slaying idea, but he settled for coming along with you.
Human Inventor

Nemoslav Jr

Nemoslav comes from a long line of incredible inventors and explorers. His great, great grandfather was said to posses a ship that could swim underwater. Nemoslav Jr is yet to acquire such renown for himself, but he is certainly bright and full of ambition.
Human Gatherer

Human Hunter

Human Young Zerca

Human Zerca

Human Healer
A wise one learned in the ways of herbs and basic medicine. Healers have always been respected, not only for their knowledge, but their willingness to help those in need.
Human Witch
Human - Young Witch

A wise woman, knowing of the mystical ways but often practicing dark magic that taints the soul and body. This is why witches, even those barely adult, can resemble old women. The young witch completed her trials, but was deemed in need of further learning.
Human - Gusla
Some boys never reach the rank of volh, instead they become gusla, a lesser magic user, focused more on research and rituals, than the raw power of magic. Only boys can become gusla.
Human - Volh

A mystic gifted with the power of foresight and the unnatural gift of creating the unliving. Only human boys can become the volh. Even though the gods have allowed their return into grace, many zercas and witches remain sceptical.
Human - Elder Volh

A mystic gifted with the power of foresight and the unnatural gift of creating the unliving. Only human boys can become the volh. Even though the gods have allowed their return into grace, many zercas and witches remain sceptical.
Human Bandit Archer
An outlaw armed with a bow, preying on the wealthy and the weak.
Human Bandit Warrior
An outlaw armed with a melee weapon, preying on the wealthy and weak.
Human Bandit Leader
A seasoned bandit rascal with a following. Known to have a weakness for pretty faces.
Human Scavenger
Abandoned by the gods long ago and driven to madness, they survive by any means neccessary.
Human Scavenger Witch

Scavengers are typically a band of unskilled ruffians, but even among their kind, the dark mark of witchcraft can be found. Scavenger witches are much more likely to fall into corruption and generally have less control than their human or orc counterparts.
Captain Bear
The leader of Red Ridge bandits who hold the entrance to an odd, red cave. Bear rules his band with a strong hand, but hides a softer heart beneath it.
Scavenger Boss Hanka
Hanka may not be the official leader of the scavenger pack, but it is clear she holds the boss by his balls and makes sure he does as she says.
Scavenger Monia

Monia is shy and timid at first glance, but you soon learn this is a front she used to stay unseen in the brutal scavenger pack. If she joins you, she will soon become more confident and full of joy for her new life.
Human Scoundrel
Slightly more sophisticated than their scavenger kin, nevertheless, hide your silverware around them. They are typically seen in the company of rats.
Elven Child
Weak Elven Guardian
this guardian barely passed their training which left many scars on their body and mind. Nevertheless they make it their goal to prove one day they can become more.
Elven Guardian
Elder Elven Guardian

Proud and stoic protectors of the wildlands. Elves tend to favour diplomacy over violence, or so they like the world to think. Despite this apparent pacifism, the elven warriors are trained from youth to be ruthless and precise. Be it 'the last resort' or 'do as we say or perish' it is not wise to stand against a guardian.
Elven Forest Craftsman
Adept at crafting beautiful items that many would consider art. These artisans tend to reject violence and focus on the art of creation; thus, diplomacy is their preferred path.
Elven Forest Gatherer
Atuned to nature and her gifts, elven gatheres are skilled at harvesting resources. They are nimble but they tend to be fragile and gentle souls.
Elven Druid
Elder Elven Druid

Wild and animalistic, druids often prefer the company of woodland kin to other humanoids, even those of their own kind. During the days of darkness, the druids were amongst the leaders who held the elven people together long enough to heal the taint of darkness and rebuild. As such, they were the most revered among their people.
Elven Banished Druid

Banished druids are an oddity even amongst their typically outsider cast of druids. They refuse to wear anything but weapons and willingly leave the forest in favour of adventure. Despite their unusual behaviours, they are actually considered whimsical and will often bring good humour to those who travel with them.
Elven Mage
Elder Elven Mage
Elven Young Mage

Keepers of ancient lore and masters of the mystical arts. Often more 'civilised' than their woodland kin due to their affinity for travel and cultural exchange. Apart from very rare exceptions, mages are actually amongst the youngest of the elven kin, because they were the first to perish when darkness took the world in the past.
Elven Shadow
Elder Elven Shadow
Corrupted by darkness long ago, a banished caste of assassins more akin to demons of the dark than their own kind.
Unbalanced Shadow Elf
Shadow elves are those who accepted their dark taint and found an odd balance on their new path. Sadly, many remain torn by their departure from light and cannot achieve this goal.
Orc Child
Orc Matriarch
Orc Wounded Matriarch

The matriarch is the leader of a clan and she must prove her worth in both combat and wits before she can claim her status. The title is not strictly hereditary, although the offspring of a previous matriarch is likely to succeed her mother.
Orc Young Matriarch
The young matriarch is one who has proven her worth and honour but was deemed too inexperienced to become a fully fledged leader of the orc tribes.
Orc Witch
Orc Young Witch

Orc witches are said to use an old and twisted form of magic, heavily reliant on blood rituals and sacrifices. How much of this is true remains unclear. Apart from magic, some whisper of their ability to commune with beasts. They are also the ones who hold the knowledge of the clans and form an advisory circle for their matriarch.
Orc Slugger
Elder Orc Slugger
Bred for killing and honour, strong, muscular and brutish, if there is more to them, you rarely get a chance to find out.
Orc Plodder
Not all orcs are destined to be warriors, but only a handful do not fear education. Plodders may be laughed at by their warrior peers, but sometimes their knowledge proves indispensable.
Orc Gatherer
Orc Young Gatherer

Strong but not really smart. Still, somebody has to do the dirty work. As with many societies, despite their low rank, the workers are the backbone of their clans. They do the work no true born orc will and because they are still orcs, they do their job with ferocity and determination.
Orc Bloodtracker

Trained seekers that can smell blood for miles. Excellent hunters of both beast or man, skilled at quick, precise kills. Other folk often call them green dogs, but the bloodtrackers have embraced this as their own.
Goblin Child
Goblin Tinkerer
Tinkerers and craftsmen known for their ingenious trinkets, but also great at everyday craftsmanship.
Goblin Toiler
Quick footed and eager to explore, the toilers are skilled at gathering resources for their villages.
Goblin Chieftain
Often referred to simply as da boss, the chieftain leads goblin families by wit and guile. Their status is often reflects in their ever growing body mass and reluctance for any physical exertion.
Tainted Shaman

The shamans are spirit walkers who are said to possess the memories of their forefathers. But sometimes, the forefathers find fault in the young shamans and leave a taint that weakens them. They can travel into the realm of the ghosts - the greyworld, and bring great wisdom or sometimes even greater peril.
Goblin Shaman

The shamans are spirit walkers who are said to possess the memories of their forefathers. They can travel into the realm of the ghosts - the greyworld, and bring great wisdom or sometimes even greater peril.
Goblin Beast Master

The beast masters are the main heavy hitters of the goblin ranks, due not to their own strength but to their extraordinary ability to train beasts as loyal brothers in arms. The beast masters do not treat their animals as mere tools; they undergo secret rituals known only to their clans and are said to share spiritual bonds.
Goblin Boar Rider

Elite goblin warriors trained to fight from their boar mounts. Boar riders train their mounts from youth to ensure the best bond and understanding between rider and boar and so this bond often becomes very strong, almost familial.
Goblin Skirmisher

Light footed and agile, while not as tough as typical warriors they are still fierce and unpredictable. They can have authority issues due to their training in separate autonomous cells. But if their clan is in danger, skirmishers are the ones to fight the long-term battles.
Dwarven Child
Dwarf Warmaster
Dwarf Young Warmaster
Chiselled in stone and metal, the warmasters are ancient, steadfast and unmovable. Dwarven warriors are feared and respected by all who know what is good for them.
Dwarf Smith
Dwarf Young Smith

There are no blacksmiths that can call themselves equal to the ancient masters of the dwarven metal arts. Apart from their craft they also often hold positions of leadership as great tacticians and sometimes orators.
Clanless Dwarf Smith

A dwarven smith with a dark past. Dwarves are driven by their sense of personal honour, thus some become clanless when they feel they failed their dwarven kin. Redemption can take time, it may never come, but a clanless dwarf will strive to achieve it still.
Dwarf Runemaster
Elder Dwarf Runemaster
The runemaster is a title given to the eldest, wisest of the dwarven smith masters who know the ancient, secret arts of carving runes.
Dwarf Labourer
Dwarven labourers are the heart and soul of their community, toiling away day and night and gathering resources vital for their kin.
Spitting Spider
Spitting spiders are known for their projectile attack.
Giant Spider
Mutated during the time of darkness, these spiders are bulky and large beyond nature.
Spider Queen
Spider queens are ferocious, large and very territorial.
Blood Bee
Changed in the days of darkness these bees are forever bloodthirsty.
Dragon Bee
Dragon bees owe their name to their thick, foreboding, armour-like shell and a fierce, fiery temperament.
Queen Bee
The queen of the hive, fiercely territorial and protective of her brood.
Mighty Queen Bee
The queen of the hive is fiercely territorial and protective of her brood and mighty queens are those who devoured many sisters to rise to this rank.
Abomination Queen
It is an abomination of spider and bee, a remnant of the days of darkness that twisted many creatures into changed, often horrid forms.
Rat

Hulking rats have become the scourge of the awakened Thea. Carrying disease and rabies, these vermin are an unwelcomed sight wherever they go. To make matters worse, rats are known associates of evil witches or the servants of bloodsucking demons.
Fat Rat
Gluttonous vermin, spreading disease and always seeking to eat more, including humanoid infants or wounded victims.
Snake
Slithering in the shadows ever seeking their next victim.
Royal Snake
Royal snakes owe their name to their massive size but also a proud, arrogant demeanour. Descendant from the zmey, these can be deadly enemies.
Starving Wolf
Starving wolves are the rejects from their pack; sometimes they form new packs of their own, ever more vicious in their drive to survive.
Wolf

Roaming the land in packs, wolves are fierce, territorial hunters and known allies of night demons. Working in packs, these night stalkers seek out prey wherever they can and are not afraid to attack humanoids.
Alpha Wolf
Alphas are the strongest and most intelligent wolves who lead their packs. Their job is to make sure wolves remain strong in Thea, and they will fight fiercely with any who claim their territory.
Young Boar
Hunted for their good meat and leather, but even a young boar can be very dangerous when rattled.
Wild Boar
Wild boars typically travel in packs which makes them formidable prey, even for a skilled hunter.
Giant Wild Boar
The giant wild boar is a true beast to watch out for. They are bigger, tougher and single-mindedly focused on defending their territory from all who challenge it.
Bat

Bloodsucking rats of the night skies, they serve foul forces and spread disease, but some still call them cute. A single creature, despite its larger size, is still relatively easy to kill, but a swarm of bats can quickly become fatal.
Striga Bat
The young of a striga, or servants made by their striga masters as a failsafe. Whatever the truth, these unliving fiends are more than mere nuisance.
Giant Crow
Seen as heralds of wisdom, but also twisted by darkness, giant crows can be a real menace.
Royal Crow
Royal crows owe their name to their superior stature and elegant demeanour. Some say there were once the chosen messengers of royalty.
Bear
Young Bear
Let the sleeping bear lie is known as smart advice in Thea.
Rabid Bear
Light-Sick Rabid Bear
Ferocious and mad, rabid bears are unpredictable and extremely dangerous.
Light sick rabid bears are weakened but no less ferocious.
Armoured Bear
Small Armoured Bear
It's a bear, wearing armour - yup.
It's a bear, wearing rusty armour - yup.
Predator Fish
They may be small, but water is their domain and within it, you are the prey.
Shark
Sharks were once a distant tale for Slavyans, but with the shattering came the sea and with it came these perfect killing machines.
Sea Serpent
Sea serpents slither silently amongst the waves seeking their prey.
Czytlica
Part aquatic part humanoid, all beast. Demons of the sea were not known to Slavyans, now they terrify all.
Young Czytlica
Part aquatic part humanoid, all beast. Demons of the sea were not known to Slavyans, now they terrify all. A young czytlica may be weaker, but she is no less brutal.
Jurata
Jurata the queens of the sea, rulers of the czytlica. Part humanoid part aquatic, they hide their cruel nature behind illusionary beauty and serene voice.
Ariel
A jurata queen, one of the first daughters of Jurasmat and Kastitys. She cursed her love, Eric, to unlife as he failed to take her to the land and give her a life as a human.
Kraken
Krakens are creatures of dark legends of old, returned after the shattering to once more bring terror to the seas.
Gosk
Once he was considered to be the master of the north sea, a god in his domain.
Jurasmat

The mother of the jurata and the queen of the underwater depths. Once a prospective god of the seas, Jurasmat was cast down and punished by the gods. Angry and vengeful, she now seeks to prove her might.
Kastitys

Once a young man, perhaps even a chosen of the gods. He was cursed to live his life as a tree that grew on the seashore. He was later awakened and partially restored, likely by his once lover Jurasmat. It is said he is the father of the jurata and czytlica, who like him, are cursed to live a life as part human, part beast.
Baba Yaga
Baba Yaga is one of the oldest Slavyan demons, but her true nature remains hidden. Is it a witch gone too far? An apparition of darkness? Or simply another tormented soul twisted by sorrow?
Skshack
Skshack is a house demon and as such, it can have mischievous nature. He is also known to do the bidding of the gods from time to time.
Divine Skshack
Divine Skshack is a house demon and as such, it can have mischievous nature. He is also known to do the bidding of the gods from time to time.
Light-Sick Poludnica
Poludnica, or the midday lady is a field demon who appears at high noon and can cause sudden death to farmers or stray children.
Poludnica
Elder Poludnica
Poludnica, or the midday lady is a field demon who appears at high noon and can cause sudden death to farmers or stray children.
Karakandza
An evil-natured, goblin-like creature that tends to prefer living underground, often tunnelling under structures to weaken them on purpose.
Light-Sick Karakandza
An evil-natured, goblin-like creature but weakened by light-sickness.
Light-Sick Cmuch
The cmuch is a shy, recluse of a demon. It lives in the swamps and is said to attack weakened or wounded folk, but it is also said to have healing properties.
Cmuch
The cmuch is a shy, recluse of a demon. It lives in the swamps and is said to attack weakened or wounded folk, but it is also said to have healing properties.
Light-Sick Bies
Bies is a dark and foreboding beast that is known to possess its victims and have them wreak havoc upon the land.
Bies
Bies is a dark and foreboding beast that is known to possess its victims and have them wreak havoc upon the land.
Syrin
Part bird, part humanoid, known to sit on rocks by the water and enchant menfolk - for that, they are sometimes confused with the jurata.
Light-Sick Syrin
Part bird, part humanoid, known to sit on rocks by the water and enchant menfolk - but this one seems weakened by light sickness.
Alkonost
Part bird, part humanoid sister of the syrin. Alkonost are very temperamental and known to turn nasty on a whim.
Light-Sick Alkonost
Part bird, part humanoid sister of the syrin. Alkonost are very temperamental and known to turn nasty on a whim and this one is infected with the light sickness.
Czort
Devious creatures, always looking for ways to be mean and have extremely high opinion of themselves.
Hohlick
Young Hohlick

Small, winged critters, with big eyes and tiny teeth. Very mischievous and playful, but they have been known to lead people astray into some real bad trouble. They can also get a bit touchy about their size and you better be careful about lending them anything as returning stuff is not their strong suit. They are very fond of games.
Pineconettes

Pineconettes are the smallest but also most common of the guardians of the forest. They take on the form of pine cones, flowers or mushrooms, or sometimes, they can become almost humanoid, the size of a toddler, but they retain some features of forest vegetation. Despite their size, they can become ferociously aggressive when in a pack.
Eldercone
Thoroughly pissed off pineconettes that have grown to become pretty vicious when needed. Or, wiser, older spirits, depends on your luck.
Leshy
Young Leshy
A young leshy will one day become the ancient shepherd of their own woodland, but for now, they need to grow and experience life so that their wisdom may flourish.
Elder Leshy
The leshy is the ancient shepherd of the forest and the grand spirit of the woodlands. They can appear as old, bearded men or walking trees.
Dormant Leshy
The dormant leshy is the ancient shepherd of the forest, but this one is not fully awakened from its tree sleep.
Light-Sick Vily
Vily are wind demons but also loyal guardians of the woodlands often serving the leshy when needed. They can appear during, or even cause a storm.
Vily
Elder Vily
Vily are wind demons but also loyal guardians of the woodlands often serving the leshy when needed. They can appear during, or even cause a storm.
Viatroviec
Elder Viatroviec
Viatroviec are spirits of the wind and nature. They often form an alliance with forest demons and serve as guardians alongside their vily sisters.
Weak Werewolf
Also known as wolf men, werewolves are seen as both blessed by the moon lord and yet cursed with the beast taint.
Werewolf
Elder Werewolf
Also known as wolf men, werewolves are seen as both blessed by the moon lord and yet cursed with the beast taint.
Striga
Those born with extra row of teeth, a unibrow, or uncommon organs all risk awakening after death to become striga and haunt their own loved ones.
Light-Sick Striga
A fiend of the night yet cursed by light, which makes it weaker, but also angrier.
Striga Master
Elder Striga Master
Light-Sick Striga Master
A striga master is adept at hiding their true nature, luring beautiful women to become his eternal brides - or dinner.
A striga master touched by the light-sickness, making him more unstable.
Striga Mistress
Elder Striga Mistress
Light-Sick Striga Mistress
A striga mistress beguiles unsuspecting men with the illusion of beauty only to lure them as her mates, or her playthings.
A striga mistress previously attacked by the lightbringers, she now carries their taint of her dark soul.
Cmok
The cmok is said to be the stallion of the striga mistress and the doom of those who see it flying in the night.
Vodnik
Elder Vodnik
Light-Sick Vodnik
Formidable and ancient water demon. Once master of the lakes and rivers, now challenged by the appearance of the seas.
Szuvarek

The king of all vodniks, he is said to be immortal. Some whisper that Szuvarek is the son of the moon itself and that he walked the land as far as the days of the giants. Others say he came to life when the first man drowned in a lake under the full moon. Whatever his origin, he lives in the emerald pond and he is the supreme king of all water demons and as such, he comes to the aid of his kin in times of great strife.
Formidable and ancient water demon that fought off an attack from the lightbringers, but not without a price. He is now weaker than his peers.
Rusalka
Elder Rusalka
The rusalkas are equal in beauty and ferocity. Unable to bear offspring without the aid of a human, they are known to lure both children and men for their own, dark desires.
Light-Sick Rusalka
The rusalkas are equal in beauty and ferocity. The light-sickness weakens her dark soul, but not her ferocious desires.
Utopiec
Often confused with the drowned, the utopiec are water demons loyal to the vodnik, territorial and less likely to use tricks favouring directness.
Befuddler
Elder Befuddler
Light-Sick Befuddler
Befuddler is the male child of a rusalka, as such he is an abomination, neither man nor water nymph, they are often killed by their own mothers.
Befuddler is the male child of a rusalka, rejected by his mother and now also tainted by light. He is not a happy fella.
Dziad Mroz
Elder Dziad Mroz
Dziad mroz is an ancient, mysterious creature roaming frozen lands in chilling silence. Seeing one would often herald a nasty winter.
Sniezynki
Elder Sniezynki
Sniezynki are ice demonettes who inhabit frozen lands, they are curious of warm blooded creatures, but can turn icy very quickly.
Light-sick Human Child
Light-taken child.
Sviatelko
A seemingly pretty light demon, but used by lightbringers to scout for victims.
Lightbringer
Mysterious light fiends that seek out the living to assimilate them into their one-mind.
Elder Lightbringer
Light-sick Human Warrior
Light-taken humans are alive and able, but only act in clusters.
Light-sick Dwarf Smith
Elder Light-sick Dwarf Smith

Dwarves are creatures carved in light, as such, they hear the call of the lightbringers loudly. Their natural resistance is high, and many die before falling to the light, but this one clearly succumbed, and now serves the light-hive.
Light-sick Spider Queen
A spider queen taken by the lightbringers and joined into their light-hive.
Broken Skeleton
Rickety, broken skeleton that has seen better unliving days.
Unliving Corpse
Walking corpse called to its unlife by some unnatural power.
Human Skeleton
Animated bones of a human, called to the unlife to serve some dark power.
Orc Skeleton
Thick, bulky bones of an orc, animated into unlife and just as keen on killing as its living counterpart.
Topielec
Unliving corpse of a drowned person brought back into unlife by dark magic.
Ghost
The spirit of a person unable or unwilling to cross over into the underworlds. Ghosts are often bound to this unlife by unresolved business, or simply a strong desire to hold on to their old life.
Wraith
Elder Wraith
Ancestor Wraith
Tormented soul that was torn out of its body and left to roam the land in anger. Wraiths are often bound to cursed objects, or places.
Unliving Rat
Called into the unlife by foul magic, they are ever more vile and disease ridden than their living kin.
Unliving Spider
Awakened back to unlife these venomous spider corpses are the stuff of nightmares.
Unliving Dragon
Once a majestic drake, now the unliving corpse animated by some dark magic.
Dragon
Blue Dragon
As old as time itself, Dragons have long been masters of the skies and keepers of greatest treasures. Some really like virgins too.
Zmey
Elder Zmey

The zmey is an ancient creature, a dragon, yet more snake like than their cousins - stories talk of one zmey who is chaos incarnate, some even whisper of his secret ties to the cosmic tree and the old god Veles. The common zmey are either his offspring or avatars. Unlike their fiery cousins, who favour physical confrontations, the zmey often employ their wits and silver, forked tongues to entice people to mischief and misery.
Swamper
Small blobs of swamp that can spit and are surprisingly talkative. They are the offspring of mud trolls, although only very few will ever grow into one.
Icicles

Icicles are thought to be the young forms of the ice trolls. They typically roam in packs and stay close to their guardian's lair. Some legends say that they are the tears of lady winter cried every spring when the snows melt and her effigy is sacrificed.
Lava Rockers
Lava Rockers are small specks of volcanic rock, the fiery offspring of the lava troll.
Rockers
Often seen as swarms of cascading pebbles, rockers are the young of rock trolls. Only some will ever grow into adults, but they are still extremely attached to their parents.
Rock Troll
Teenage Rocker

Not quite a troll yet, but no longer a baby, teenage rockers are known for their mood swings, brooding and making a lot of unnecessary noise. There is none alive who has devised a way of dealing with it all, one must simply survive it.
The most common of trolls. Likes to eat, especially humans. Prone to bribery and guarding bridges for money.
Swamp Troll
Swamp Troll Youngster

Not quite a troll yet, but no longer a baby, swamp troll youngsters can be very volatile and moody. Their natural shyness becomes even more pronounced, and they become hypersensitive to any form of criticism, so one must be extra careful when dealing with them.
The least violent of troll kind, but no lesss dangerous when pushed. Their natural habitat is swamps, but some can settle outside.
Ice Troll Youth

Not quite a troll yet, but no longer a baby, the ice troll youths are known to become extra icy and mean during this volatile period. Prone to dramatic outbursts, or unreasonably long periods of isolation and sulking, the youths are best left t their own devices until adulthood.
Ice Troll
Solitary creature seen mainly in the desolate ice plains. They are said to be ruled by the dziod mroz, like every other creature of the ice plains.
Teenage lava rocker

Not quite a troll yet, but no longer a baby, teenage lava rockers are known for their fiery mood swings followed by long periods of intense brooding, that can end it sudden, hot outbursts of aggression. There is none alive who has devised a way of dealing with it all, one must simply survive it.
Lava Troll
Risen from the hot pits of molten lava, these trolls are extremely aggressive and like to incinerate folks and challenge them to unfair duels.
Mroki

Said to have been a giant during the awakening, taken by darkness and twisted into a creature of the shadows. The mroki now dwell in the lands of darkness, together with shadow elves they form the Shadowkin.
Elder Mroki
Said to have been a giant during the awakening, taken by darkness and twisted into a creature of the shadows. As an elder of its kind, this mroki is especially dangerous.
Light Beast
The corpse of a zmey, an elder creature of darkness, taken by the light beast when it escaped from the core of the earth.
Dwarven Guardian Statue
Ancient guardians of dwarven treasures and sacred places deep in the earth's core. Some say they are actual dwarven champions turned to stone and metal to serve for eternity.
Failed Summon
This is what you get when you try your hand at summoning something you can't handle.
Kraken Tentacle
Kraken tentacles have a life of their own and you best avoid their attention.
Sea Vine
Sea Vines fill all the battle field by the will of Mikolay.
Dzievanna's Feral
Elder Dzievanna's Feral
Once they were an elven druid, now they follow the path of the forest fully shedding any constraints of civilisation in favour of becoming a beast.
Dzievanna's Feral
The call of the wild drove these elven druids to become truly one with nature. Wild and free they roam the forest ever vigilant and very territorial.
Cradle Possum
Young Cradle Possum
A vicious, rodent-like creature known to steal away children in its sack.
Light-Sick Roggnyr
A rare forest demon that doesn't actually like the company of animals. This one is clearly infected with light-sickness, making it weaker, but likely meaner too.
Roggnyr
Elder Roggnyr
A rare forest demon that doesn't actually like the company of animals. Beware, they carry grudges like their wrinkles once crossed!
Enchanted Roggnyr
This typically elusive forest demon has taken possession of an enchanted pipe that allows him to lure children into his twisted lair, where he drains their blood for power.
Warrax

A hooded warrior clad in heavy armour and roaming the land to seek revenge. Once a legendary warlord of Perun, his soul was stolen by the machinations of dwarven runemasters and bound to eternal servitude.
Menavca
Elder Menavca
A mysterious and rare demon that is said to have the ability to mimic its victims.
Bog Bies
A mysterious creature found lurking the swamps. They are often thought to be an offshoot of the bies, and as such considered as deceptive and dangerous.
Alchemist
Only known as the Alchemist, a figure clad in mystery, but clearly in service of your gods, or is he?
Vihur
A wind elemental demon that is often in leagues with witches for some reason. They thrive during storms but are typically harmless if you stay out of their way.
Forest Fairy

These days more commonly known as tooth fairy, a self-imposed re-branding. It is a fierce and often outright mean creature that does not wait for you to leave teeth under your pillow as some naive storytellers will tell. Instead, folk who have toothache take special care to try and ward off from the forest fiend, before it rips the offending tooth out by force.
Orc Necromancer
A rare creature indeed, as most orc males with magic are killed. Perhaps his profession explains that?
Necromancer
Necromancers meddle with the dark arts of life and death and in doing so, they tend to break the laws of nature to create their unliving abominations.
Beast
Demon
Warrakus
Elder Warrakus
The origin or nature of the warrakus is unclear. It is a creature of pure metal and yet it is animated. Some call it demon work, curse, others whisper of dwarven handiwork.
Light-Sick Warrakus

The origin or nature of the warrakus is unclear. It is a creature of pure metal and yet it is animated. Some call it demon work, curse, others whisper of dwarven handiwork. The light seems unable to claim them, but it does weaken the metal.
Iron Storm

Iron Storm is a young warrior of stone and iron who has proven his unshaken loyalty to the dwarven kin time and again. If he agrees to join you it is to show your young gods what a true dwarf is made of.
Dark Totem
This statue of carved stone contains spirits of your forefathers, eager to help you in a challenge.
No Class
This is a concept and has no class.
Wooden Bear
An animated wooden sculpture, beautifully carved to depict an axe-bearing wild bear. Bears are not known to be gentle even on a good day, but this one seems particularly hell-bent on murder.
Hell Hounds
Affectionately called hell hounds, although no one is quite sure what the ‘hell’ stands for. Some speculate a connection to the underworlds.
Two Hell Hounds

Two black dogs, affectionately called hell hounds by their master - although no one in Slavya knows what this hell refers to? These two pups used to be good dogs, attacking only undesirables and small critters, but something or someone made them crave more blood.
Tomislav - Treasure Demon

Tomislav is the leader of Bear Village, a self professed 'boss' who seems to care for his home a great deal. He is also a treasurer demon, who would typically be found in caves and dungeons, guarding some long lost jewels. This one has clearly found a new calling.
Forefather Spirits

The forefathers are the souls of the ancestors, also referred to as dziody. They are old souls, wise but proud and easy to anger. Folk of Slavya have long honoured the forefathers with all souls celebrations, asking for their wisdom and protection in exchange for the veneration.
Possessed Pumpkin
Possessed Elder Pumpkin
Possessed Ancient Pumpkin
Nasty orange vegetables, mindlessly roaming the lands. They like sweets a lot and have been known to get violent when you don’t give them some.
Sea Dragon
Sea dragon is extremaly rare. Only thing that is know about them is that they destroy armor realy fast.
Elven Slave

The blue orc pirates, like any bandit in Thea, do not shy away from the slave trade. But on their own ships, they keep only the elven slaves, believing this to be a sign of dominance and strength. Elves enslaved by the blue orcs resemble their free kin in every way, except their eyes are sad and empty and their bodies weakened from the mistreatment.
Blue Pirate
Elder Blue Pirate

The blue pirates are known for their ferocity and love of conflict. When they first emerged, migrants from the broken Westernlands, they were a mere rubble of blood thirsty orcs seeking a new life. But then it was said they found a new master, one who whispered to them from deep beneath the waters. In time they became more organised and thus more dangerous. Pirate is the most common rank, given to any hopeful that managed to kill their first enemy or find good treasure.
Boatswain
Young boatswain

In the good old tradition of pirate lore, the boatswain are the petty officers of any good ship. They are the ones who ensure smooth sailing, and they are the ones who pay for any rough rides. Many captains have risen from the rank of boatswain.
Cooper

The cooper is a skilled craftsman who takes care of the maintenance of the ship. Despite their brutish culture, the blue pirates know full well they could not sail without their brainiacs. The coopers thus enjoy a good reputation and protection from their crew.
Brutes

Bulky, misshapen oafs, the brutes are the muscle of the blue pirates, not too smart, but brutal in combat. All blue pirates have undergone aquatic mutations over the centuries, most likely gifts from their master. The brutes seem to have fallen in the cauldron when said mutations were handed out.
Quartermaster

Powerful and mysterious characters, often feared the most by those who see beyond only brute force. The quartermasters are the neck of any good ship. It is them who steer their captains in the right direction. They must walk the line between the crew and the leader, to ensure they are friend to both. The quartermasters are also blessed by the deep waters with mystical power that allows them to guide the ship even among the worst of conditions.
Pirate Captain

There are many ways one can become captain on a pirate ship and none is pretty. As such, they are typically mean, rough and standoffish so that they may rule with an iron hand. A captain can be challenged at any time, so they need to remain sharp, vigilant and strong. Many lose limbs, or wits during their climb to power, and so they can often have peg legs and odd pets as companions.
Captain Eric

The captain of an unliving ship, manned by men bound to the unlife by some old curse. Some call the captain prince, as this was once his station. Eric’s life force is bound to his old lover, a jurata, but the two have long been apart.
Pirate child
A young blue orc, born into the pirate life and so destined to grow up as a plunderer and rogue.
Ghost Ballista
That ballista has a screaming soul chained to it.
Sea Thing

A creature born of the depths of the oceans crawled out onto land by some wicked design of its masters. No one really knows how this thing came to life or what its true design may be, but they are often found in the company of the blue pirates. This coalition suggests the two may share a common master.
Young Berserker
Berserker

Berserkers come from a foreign land in the north. They are fierce warriors who embrace their destiny and allow the spirit of the bear to guide them into battle. When enraged, they can hurt both friend and foe.
Polar Bear
Young Polar Bear

Polar bears used to be the stuff of tall tales from up north, but with the Shattering and the emergence of the ice lands, these ferocious winter lovers have been spotted even in Slavya. Thick skinned and easily angered, these bears can be very dangerous.
Dwarf Grunt
Common timber suitable mostly for firewood.
Baby Rat
A cute, white, baby rat.
Warrat
Touched by the influence of the Tzarat, or perhaps naturally gifted, the warrat has evolved beyond their vermin limitations and become a fearsome fighter.
Healrat
Touched by the influence of the Tzarat, or perhaps naturally gifted, the healrat is a gifted medic, wise beyond their usual vermin limits.
Mystrat
Touched by the influence of the Tzarat, or perhaps naturally gifted, the mystrat rose from a witch's familiar to a true wielder of the dark arts.
Tzarat

The Tzarat is a self proclaimed rat king, an evolved specimen of the vermin, that has grown in power and stature to equal any humanoid. It is also possible the Tzarat is an effect of some terrible experiment gone wrong, and worse yet, other rats can become one too!
Gnoll Pup
A gnoll pup is cute as a button, but beware, it may bite!
Gnoll Warmonger
The most aggressive and tough of the gnoll pack, the warmongers are fierce fighters with territorial tendencies.
Gnoll Seeker
The seekers use their canine blood to great advantage, especially at night, as they scout and hunt for their pack.
Gnoll Mystic
The gnoll mystics are rare and to many folk, most unexpected in such a primal peoples. Thay are most akin to shamans in their approach to the magical arts.
Young Matrioshka
Matrioshka

The matrioshka are extremely rare amongst the dwarven folk, they are always female and they wield old magic. Until recently they remained an underground secret. They have some ancient connection to the baba yaga, who is said to be their spiritual mother.
Gargamus
An old magician, travelling from another realm. He decided to join you for a time.
Ginger Cat
A ginger house cat, mangy looking but oddly smart. He was the the previous overlord of one called Gargamus, he now chooses to have you serve him.
Freya
A mysterious wizard from far away lands, or perhaps even from another realm.
Alfredo the Lover
The blue pirates are known for their ferocity and love of conflict, but Alfredo has always been more of a lover than a fighter.
Ralf Rattlebones
Ralf may be an unliving corpse, but that has not stopped him from searching for that one person, who may revive his rotten heart.
Loverrat

Touched by the influence of the Tzarat, or perhaps naturally gifted, the warrat has evolved beyond their vermin limitations and become a fearsome fighter, but surprisingly, also a battle worthy lover.
Babina

The matrioshka are extremely rare amongst the dwarven folk, they are always female and they wield old magic. Babina is a young matrioshka, who seeks to find her own way, and true love while she's at it!'

The matrioshka extremely rare amongst the dwarven folk, they are always female and they wield old magic. Until recently they remained an underground secret. The young matrioshka are astute pupils of their elders, not yet as strong, but still formidable.
Befuddlers are tragic creatures, shunned by their rusalka mothers for their beastly side. Lovelace strives to find love and thus prove that he is a true nymph like his mothers!

Clarissa may be a scavenger, but her inner beauty shines through the worn exterior and the light of Lada herself warms Clarissa's gentle heart. The young witch is searching for love, but also seeks to better the hearts of others.
Love Sick Warrakus

The origin or nature of the warrakus is unclear. It is a creature of pure metal and yet it is animated. Some call it demon work, curse, others whisper of dwarven handiwork. This one is even stranger than their fellows, as they seek to become more human and also find true love...
Wood
Common timber suitable mostly for firewood.
Dryad Wood
Fabled to be the gift of the dryads. Black wood that releases golden resin when cut.
Dark Wood
Wood from a forest tainted by darkness long ago. If used carefully it can be crafted in many ways.\n\nWild resource ({ICON:WildResourceIcon}).

Amber
Fossilized tree resin, commonly used in crafting.

Diamond
Diamond is not only a girl's best friend, everyone likes it. It's rare, tough and beautiful.

Rare crafting material and trophy. Sharp as mithril, tough as stone, mighty as the fallen drakes themselves.

Rare leather, typically found on those who were born of magic.\n\nWild resource ({ICON:WildResourceIcon}).

Found only on the most rare, mythical beasts, valued for its durability and beauty.

Low Fuel Alert

Low Health Alert

One or more characters has below 30% Health and may die. If the Health drops to 0, the character will not participate in any challenges. Set up a camp to speed up health recovery.\n\nClick to open the affected group's inventory.
Low Sanity Alert

One or more characters has below 30% Sanity and their morale is decreased. Their damage is lowered and there's a chance they will leave your group. 

Improve their Morale by providing varied food.

Click to open the affected group's inventory.
Low Faith Alert

One or more characters below 30% Faith and are poisoned by magic. They will receive damage equal to portion of their health each turn. If the Faith drops to 0, the character will not participate in any challenges. Perform the Spiritual Healing ritual and/or improve Morale to regenerate Faith.\n\nClick to open the affected group's inventory.
Low Morale Alert

One or more characters feels their Morale is very low may leave to look for a better future away from you. Provide varied meals, let them rest and keep their Sanity high to recover Morale.\n\nClick to open the affected group's inventory.
Overburdened Character Alert

One or more characters has equipped items that weigh more than they can handle. If you do not take action and balance character carry limits, some of character's stuff will be taken off randomly and droped to inventory.\n\nClick to open the affected characters equipment screen.

One of your groups is carrying more than they can handle and will suffer penalties. Their movement is reduced by 1MP for every 10% of weight they carry above their limit.\n\nClick to open the affected group's inventory.

Mountains

Mountain ranges on the Slavyan natural lands can be a good source of resources. There are caves and quarries hidden amongst the rocks, but beware of bears or bandits in the lairs. Although trolls are unlikely to dwell here, their offspring, the rockers are more common.
Hills
Although not as steep as mountains, hills can provide hideouts for many dangerous creatures of Thea, but you can also discover caves and quarries ripe for exploring.
Swamps
Swamps have always attracted dark creatures and mischievous demons, as well as swampers, so one should always remain on guard when trying to brave a swamp.
Plains
Plains stretch throughout the land and are one of the most common land types. Beware of field demons who favour this terrain.
Dryland

Dryland is often the remnant of the light burning away all that stood in its way. It is typically a barren terrain, deserts filled with nothing but sand, although abandoned ruins or cemeteries are not uncommon. Beware of dirt storms or quicksand.
Forest
Forests have been slowly regaining their strength after the darkness many ages ago. They can be the lifesaving source of wood, but beware of forest guardians who may not take kindly to your presence.
Darkness Mountains

Mountain ranges in the lands of darkness are often places of safe haven from the black mist that plagues the lowlands, or so many hope. That hope often proves futile when one is faced with the mroki, who have an affinity for mountain tops.
Darkness Hills

In the lands swept up by gusts of the black mist, a remnant of darker times, hillsides can quickly become treacherous. You may find old quarries and hidden caves here, but beware of what may lurk within.
Darkness Swamps

Swamps of Darkness - ordinary swamps are considered gloomy, odd places filled with dangers lurking in the mist. But when you find yourself on the swamps of darkness, that seems like a kind description.
Darkness Plains

Plains of Darkness are filled with the bones of creatures who fell to the dread of the black mist. For reasons unknown the dark force lingers here and continues to diminish any chance of these plains blooming again.
Darkness Dryland

In the lands ravaged by darkness, dryland remain as a reminder of its destructive force. No life can truly thrive here, at least not one that isn't filled with the dangerous force. It is perhaps the reason for the banished shadow elves and their new kin, the mroki to favour such terrain and call it theirs.
Darkness Forest

Forests of Darkness are unusual places. The trees remain twisted with the taint, turning them into dark wood, or simply hollow husks. More likely than green oaks are great, towering fungal growths, glowing in unhealthy colours in the night. This is likely why many goblin tribes decided to settle here.
Ice Mountains
The icy peaks of the moutain ranges on these lands are as treacherous as they are lonely. Here the dziad mroz and his grandauthers the sniezynki hold dominion and they do not like visitors.
Ice Hills

Icy hillsides may look pretty with the calm, blanket of snow wrapped around every curve. But beware of the old ruins, abandoned caves where only the heartless creatures of the ice, or long forgotten spirits of old dwell.
Ice Swamps

Ice swamps are an odd phenomenon. Despite the ever-low temperature, the earth here remains hot and thus creates these pockets of quicksand and mud hidden beneath the ice. Beware, ice trolls are just as likely to dwell here as their kinder cousins from the mud.
Ice Plains

In these quiet, lonesome lands, the ice plains can stretch for miles. Occasionally, one can encounter ruins of old cities, frozen in time and often guarded by the lost spirits of their once inhabitants.
Ice Drylands

Icy drylands, like the ice plains, can stretch to the horizon. Although this land is devoid of life, you may still find stray beasts here and they will surely be looking for their next meal, any meal.
Ice Forest

The frozen forests of the icy land are beautiful in their own right. Ice demons, ruled by the dziad mroz, will sometimes choose the forests as their frozen home. One should be very careful to visit such dwellings, as creatures of the ice do not like the warm blooded much.
Volcanic Mountains

Volcanic Mountains stick out of the land like protruding black claws of a fire beast. Ash clouds, lava pits and eruptions are only the tip of the fire mount. Lava trolls favour the mountains as their domain, and they are amongst the most aggressive of their kind.
Volcanic Hills
Vulcanic hillsides are ash-covered mounds filled with treacherous lava pits and roming bands of orc bandits.
Volcanic Swamps
Volcanic Swamps are steaming hot-spots. Orc clans use them as scorching bathhouses, although it is not a recommended holiday spot for any other folk.
Volcanic Plains
Filled with scorched grass and ash covered fields, it is not easy to be a farmer on the volcanic lands, this is probably why most orc clans live from raiding.
Volcanic Dryland

Drylands are the staple terrain of the volcanic lands. Cracked earth, steaming hot-spots and lava pits. Occasionally, one can find the scorched ruins of old cities, or burial grounds for warriors fallen in some great battle.
Volcanic Forest

The elves would not call these burned out husks trees nor the ash-covered groupings of the husks as forests, but this is what the volcanic land has to offer. If any live trees do survive and thrive on this harsh soil, they are to be admired.
Ancient Forest Mountains

The green mountain tops on the ancient forest lands are often referred to as sleeping giants by the elder kin. But is this is a metaphor to describe their grandeur and shape, or a factual description?
Ancient Forest Hills

Evergreen mounds filled with exotic plants and hidden alcoves. Damage done by the darkness in the past and the scorching light since the Shattering diminished the plenitude, but these hills remain a sight of beauty.
Ancient Forest Swamps
The swamps on this ancient land are old and mysterious. Many creatures unwanted in the main forest seek refuge here, so travellers should remain wary.
Ancient Forest Plains

The plains of the ancient forest lands area a mesmerising display of exotic plant life and exuberant colours. The bed of flowers creates a sweet smell that can make you forget how dangerous the world is.
Ancient Forest Drylands
In the old days there would be no dryland where the elder races dwell. But the devastation of the days of darkness and now the scorching infestation of the light have left their ugly mark.
Ancient Forest Woodland

The woodland is of course the heart and soul of the ancient forest. Treelines soaring sky-high dwarf anyone who walks amongst them. These old woodlands are home not only to the elven folk, but also to the most revered forest demons who remain vigilant in protecting this last true haven of nature.
Metallic Mountains

Metallic Mountains are the new surface home of the dwarves, who now call themselves the Earthbound, to remember that one day they must return to their true abode. These mountains are steep and ravelled with tunnels and caves. Rock trolls and dragons also favour them as their lair.
Metallic Hills

Metallic lands came to being after the Shattering threw out the home of the dwarves onto the surface. As such, the hills here are an odd amalgamation of stone and metal. You can come across ruins of the dwarven cities that fell long ago, or the sacred burial grounds spit out onto the surface.
Metallic Swamps
Swamps and quicksand are ever a dangerous place for wanderers, but in the lands of metal and stone they can be an interesting sight, with metallic water surfaces and stone shrubbery.
Metallic Plains
In the harsh lands of metal and stone, the plains are grey and solemn as if grass itself decided to toughen up and show a true dwarven spirit.
Metallic Drylands
While drylands and steppes in other lands are often seen as wastelands, here they are valued for their occasional source of good stone.
Metallic Forest

Dwarves are not fond of woodlands and their homeland seems to share this sentiment. Trees here are scarce, and more often than not their bark becomes infested with a metallic tinge, or a stone sickness that prevents growth.

Alpha clans
You have discovered the main settlement of the alpha clans.

The orcs are traditionally a nomadic clan-based society, ruled by clan matriarchs. The alpha matriarch oversees all the clans, and she holds power in the settled orc villages. Orcs despise cowardice, so think twice before you choose to surrender in their presence.\n\nOrcs will not typically trade for bone or leather since they usually have those materials in abundance. When you become friends, you may be able to recruit an orc via the fighting pits. To gain friendship, you can try doing tasks for the alphas when they are available.

The Slavyans are the largest, most stable community of humans who worship the Cosmic Tree Pantheon. Some of your own folk likely came from a Slavyan village before they were thrown into the path of the chosen and forced to forge their own path. Slavyans accept all trade goods, and once friendly, you will be able to recruit up to two humans from the tavern.

Scavengers.
You have discovered the main settlement of the scavengers.

They are the second largest human community, but they are not followers of the pantheon. As the story goes, scavengers were folk who displeased the gods and thus never received their protection during the days of Darkness. They became wilder, often ridden with disease and madness. These days they form more organised societies and are known for slave trade across the land. You may be able to acquire some slaves from them, or even sell your own people.

Dzievanna

I walk in the watchful shadow of the old mother earth who lies silent. I listen to her whispers and sing her songs. Mistress of the forests, spirit of nature, lady of the earth - those are the names mortals call me. But do not be fooled by the beauty of my domain, by the desire to uphold life and treasure balance above all.

Nature is not your calmly mother. Cross my path in defiance of the eternal laws and you will learn the fury of the forests. For I am also the huntress. Silent and vigilant, true to my cause and unwavering in my resolve. Defile my domain at your own peril and taste the whisper of the forest at your shoulder before death comes for you!

Walk with me amongst the trees if you dare.
Horz

From the shadows of the night and the terrors of darkness ever lurking in the corners, I rise! Reborn anew in the weaves of the moon's magic, I stand as the master of the night and keeper of the moon. Monsters and beasts, demons and fiends they all roam my domain. It is up to me to keep them in check to rule, dominate and destroy those who disobey!

I am a shadow stalker, a howler in the night. I run with the wolves and dance with the stars. I rule the dark to make sure the light does not conquer all. It is a task unloving, lonesome and cruel, but it is a path I will walk for as long as the moon hangs in the skies.

Do not fear the darkness, master it!
Lada

I was born in the darkest hour of our land, from the seed of hope held in the hearts of our people. The long night sought to diminish all light and love from our hearts, but it could not do so. In the absence of the father who once led us and the mother who was our keeper, I now stand at the head of our pantheon, so that hope remains in the times of the ever-persistent turmoil.

Mistake me not for a fragile flower seeking only the fertile ground to spawn its seeds. Beauty and hope can yet turn their blossoming petals into shards of steel and thunder when the time is right. The path of peace is rarely peaceful.

But if your heart beats strong and your will is made of iron, join me on the road to harmony.
Marovit

Wisdom and knowledge flow in unsteady currents through our world, and I am their student. I seek no dominance, nor claim to hold the reins of such rivers, no. The mind and the soul will forever remain mysteries and we, be it mortals or eternals, we can only gaze upon the surface of the great oceans of understanding.

Spirit walker, sage, keeper of the keys of knowledge and mysticism - those are the names childishly attached to my domains. I am but a mere servant of the wills of the ocean, a lone sailor seeking to enlighten others. Mortals forget that they are not the masters of our lands, they forget or reject it, but I am here to remind them all of the power of the otherworlds.

Seek wisdom, fear not the unknown, wield the weaves of magic as your sword.
Nyia

Forgotten, abandoned, diminished, alone... For centuries I was but a mere memory... Nay not even that. But the lady of winter is no more, the master of the underworlds is gone. And finally, I take my place once more. Mistress of death, bringer of sorrow, keeper of solace and demise.

Only I can traverse the lands of the dead - the navyas, only I can carry the souls of the faithful to their homes and peace. Yet it is not a service well received. I do not mourn for the dead, I do not weep for the dying, it is all as it should be, as it was made to be - and sometimes, when the laws are broken, death will be served by my hand. I have suffered in the darkness. Now I bring suffering and its end, infinitely.

Join me? Why would you, fool?
Stribog

The world has shattered, earth has moved and oceans flooded our homes. No longer can we stay in one place, we must move, conquer, explore! From the winds of the north I bear the ice will to fight. From the winds of the west I will bless your travels with swiftness. From the currents of the east I will whisper wisdom and from the warm embrace of the southern breeze I will give comfort on your journey forwards.

I was once a spirit of the winds, free, wild and untamed - but I heard the call of the cosmic tree as the earth crumbled beneath it. I was called by my brothers and sisters, I was called by my people who raised their hands to the skies and asked for good winds. I am now the god of the journey, a pathfinder, a path giver and guide.

Come with me into the winds and know true freedom.
Svarog

From the flames of the sky and the ashes of darkness past, I rise to my duty! Sun god and master of heavenly fires - that is my honour to bear. But as I once wielded a warrior's garb I now know the true power of light and fire, the simple hearth that lights the homes and hearts of my flock.

It is not the power of the gods that will save our lands, but the power we can grant to our faithful. In the scorching flames of my domain rise the tools and weapons of true heroes, mortals and immortals alike, sworn to uphold my iron will.

Protect those in need, never back down, never give in and never again allow darkness to rule over light!
Triglav

Argh! From the scorching lava seeping out of the ashes of our land, I was forged! Veins of wrath pulsate throughout my body with rage and purpose. My stone hearts beat in unison, my minds meld into one vision, my fists are driven trifold. I do not know who raised me from the darkness. I do not know why our hearts melt with anger, but I am ready to stand and fight against any who will dare to oppose us!

A new force rises to devour Thea once again and I will stand in its way. This is why I have risen from fire. Walk with me into war, burn our enemies to the ground, melt away those who seek to wound us, crush whoever stands in the path of divine justice and wrath.

And you? You are to bow before me and obey!
Zorya

My father claims the right to be master of light and the sun, but it is we who ride the night skies in their infinity! The morning star rises far and faded, it is subtle and ever watchful of her enemies. The noon star hangs low and heavy, ready to rush into combat and devour its enemies. The evening star lights up the skies and readies for war! Zorya, Zorza, the Auroras, all names given to us by those brave enough to follow!

I am the bright blade of the night and the shining gauntlet of the day. I hold the beast that would devour our world in my palm and I laugh in the face of the enemy. Be bold, be brutal and swift.

Enemies of balance grow in strength once more, I will tear them apart and devour their entrails! Join me!
Mokosh

Mother Nature, Earth Mother, Tree Sister - names given to me in times past. Life itself is my privy, and it is life that I guard with my shield and spear. A mother's touch can be soothing, but a mother's wrath is unyielding!

I was once one, master of all, then I became three so that fire would cleanse this sick land of mine. Now I return as the seas call out to me, whispering of old enemies seeking revenge.

Come into my embrace, respect life, but do not fear death in my arms!

When you have finished your actions, press the {COLOR:yellow}End Turn{END_COLOR} button located in the bottom right corner of the screen.

Resources

There are different types of {COLOR:yellow}resources{END_COLOR} in the world. They can be used as {COLOR:yellow}crafting materials, food or fuel{END_COLOR}, but before your people can use them - they need to collect them.

Move your group near a tile with a resource located no further than one hex away.\n\nTo assign your workers to collecting resources, your group has to be in {COLOR:yellow}Camp Mode.{END_COLOR}

You have just started a card minigame.
Each round consists of {COLOR:yellow}8 Preparation Phases{END_COLOR} and {COLOR:yellow}2 Fight Phases{END_COLOR}.

To win, eliminate all of your enemy's cards.
During {COLOR:yellow}Preparation Phases{END_COLOR} players take turns to play their cards.

Actions Points ({ICON:APIcon}) and Delay ({ICON:DelayIcon}) are explained a bit later.

During the {COLOR:yellow}Preparation Phases{END_COLOR}, fighters on each side are getting ready but they do not engage the enemy just yet.

This is when you play the cards, select which skills to use, cast spells etc.

Each decision you make during your turn cannot be changed once the card is placed on the battlefield.
{COLOR:green}Ally Turn{END_COLOR}

- Cards can be played mutliple times, but each time they are played, their casting cost increases by 1{ICON:APIcon}\n\n- You may decide to save your Action Points (AP) and use them in your next Preparation Phase.
{COLOR:red}Enemy Turn{END_COLOR}

Rules of {COLOR:yellow}playing a card{END_COLOR}:

- To play a card, you need to pay its casting cost ({ICON:APIcon})

- Each card may have one or more actions (skills) available - pick one.
When you run out of Action Points - click {COLOR:yellow}End Turn{END_COLOR}. You will receive more APs ({ICON:APIcon}) after your opponent ends their turn.
When all Preparation Phases end, {COLOR:yellow}Fight Phases{END_COLOR} begin.
{COLOR:yellow}Queue{END_COLOR} on the right hand side of the screen shows order of actions.\n\nCards with the lowest delay {ICON:DelayIcon} are at the top and will act first.
How quickly a card will act depends on the Delay value {ICON:DelayIcon} of the skill they use and also on their Wits {ICON:WitsIcon} attribute.
The outcome of the {COLOR:yellow}Fight phase{END_COLOR} will decide if another Round is needed. The challenge will last for as long as both players have cards to play during the Preparation phases.

A character's {COLOR:yellow}equipment{END_COLOR} greatly influences how well they perform during a challenge and what {COLOR:yellow}skills{END_COLOR} they can use.

Welcome to your first challenge!
Let's teach you some basics, so you know what's going on.
The challenge screen consists of:
- {COLOR:yellow}Hand{END_COLOR} - these are your cards,
- {COLOR:yellow}Battlefield{END_COLOR} - where you and your enemy place the cards you want to play,
- {COLOR:yellow}Sequence Bar{END_COLOR} - shows order of actions,
- {COLOR:yellow}Turn Indicators{END_COLOR} - status of the current round.
You and your enemy take turns to play your cards during {COLOR:yellow}Preparation Turns.{END_COLOR}
Your Turns
Enemy Turns
All actions are placed in a queue (Sequence Bar shows the order) and executed later, in Fight Turns.
Playing a card  for the first time costs 1 Action Point ({ICON:APIcon}).
{COLOR:yellow}To play a card:{END_COLOR}
1. Click on a card on your Hand.\n2. Select an action.\n3. Click on a slot on the Battlefield.
Show Me
When you spend your APs ({ICON:APIcon}), end your turn and your enemy will have a chance to perform their actions.
Each of you will have a total of {COLOR:yellow}4 Preparation Turns{END_COLOR} and you will get APs ({ICON:APIcon}) at the start of each turn.
You can play the same character more than once.
Each time you play the same character, its AP  cost increases by {ICON:APIcon}1.
You will see a {COLOR:yellow}Clone{END_COLOR} icon on each card that has been played more than once.
Its colour will be different if cloned units are different.
Each action that targets one of the Clones will have effect on all of them.
When the Preparation Turns end, {COLOR:yellow}Fight Turns{END_COLOR} begin.
Characters will exchange blows and perform actions according to the order on the {COLOR:yellow}Sequence Bar.{END_COLOR}
Actions with lowest {COLOR:yellow}Delay{END_COLOR} ({ICON:DelayIcon}) will be performed first.
If there is no winner after the first round, another round will start.
The challenge will last until either you or your enemy lose all their characters.

This is a {COLOR:yellow}Challenge vs Concept{END_COLOR}. In challenges vs Concept you cannot use skills that come from equipped items. In other words - only your natural abilities count here.
If your characters do not have a suitable skill that can be used in a challenge they are in, they will be able to use a default attack, but it is not very effective.
Losing (or forfeiting) a challenge against a concept may also have bad consequence, but it usually doesn't affect your characters' hit points.
By the way - during Fight Turns you will see Animation Speed slider appear in this spot.
It allows you to change how fast the fight and attack effects are played.
In this fight your characters have some items at their disposal.
Items come with different skills and using them correctly will improve your chance of winning.
Skills may have different usage rules that define what they can target, when their effects are triggered and what kind of effect is applied at the time they are triggered.
When deciding on which skill to use, hover over each icon to see how the skill works.
For example - the {COLOR:yellow}Wand{END_COLOR} held by {COLOR:yellow}Anya{END_COLOR} is a {COLOR:yellow}ranged weapon{END_COLOR}. You can only use it from your {COLOR:yellow}ranged row{END_COLOR}.
Ranged weapons can target any enemy character, unless there is one standing in the melee row in front of its user, blocking their view.
You will be able to pick a target during Fight Turns. However, if Anya gets blocked by an enemy, this enemy must be targeted.

{COLOR:yellow}Kamil{END_COLOR} holds a scroll with {COLOR:yellow}Lullabye{END_COLOR} skill. Using it will {COLOR:yellow}instantly{END_COLOR} increase Delay ({ICON:DelayIcon}) of an enemy character on the Battlefield, causing them to act later than they would normally do.
Unlike weapon attacks, instant skills apply their effect when you confirm the target(s).

Oh dear, these bandits don't stand a chance against the pure awesomeness of your dwarves.
Let's use this fight as an opportunity to explain Shielding, True and Splash Damage.
{COLOR:yellow}Shielding{END_COLOR} protects your characters' hit points and normally is taken off first. It is replenished between challenges but not between rounds.
One of your dwarves is carrying {COLOR:yellow}a shield{END_COLOR}, which allows him to protect another ally by increasing their Shielding.

He also carries a Hatchet, which deals an improved version of {COLOR:yellow}True Damage{END_COLOR} ({ICON:DamageTrueAncient}). Not only will your dwarf deal full damage to hit points, but also deal the same amount of damage to the enemy's Shielding.

Your other dwarf is equipped with a Mallet. This is a slow, but a rather powerful weapon that does {COLOR:yellow}Splash Damage{END_COLOR} ({ICON:DamageTSplash}). It will damage enemies that stand next to your character's main target.
Hover your mouse over a character on the Battlefield to see their target(s).
If {COLOR:yellow}Clones{END_COLOR} are standing next to each other, they will all be affected by the splash and receive a lot more damage.
Try to take advantage of this fact when playing a splash damage skill and be careful how you place your units if you suspect an enemy might have a splash damage weapon.

Attack!

Try to physically pull the boy away from this place of magic, even though you know this is the riskiest path.

Wait for the boy to wake up.

'I... I am not sure. It was so dark and confusing. So many voices, all telling me to do stuff. Ask the boy where the dragon is, but leave him here -- he needs to find his own way from now on.

Fight!

Leave.

It also severs any magic links to unclean creatures that the child had called to unlife. The boy's spirit, cleansed and calm, becomes yours to command.
Take the spirit and leave this place.

The boy is stuck in the greyworld, a place where spirits dwell and darkness runs amok. All who are gifted in mystical power have to undergo a journey there, but clearly this boy is not doing well.
He looks at you, seeming scared, but he cannot hear you. The child is stuck. You can almost reach him one moment, then he becomes distant again. If you grab him, perhaps you could pull him out by sheer force, although you know full well it is madness to try it...
Pull him out!
Kill the boy and end his misery.

Leave this place.
Attack!

Leave.

Leave.

Take what you can and leave.

The water bubbles, and you hear something heavy plunge into the depths. The sea goes quiet afterward, but you feel good for doing the deed.
Leave.

Begin the harvest.
Begin the harvest.
